testCases.name: CI regression guards reject movable Action refs and unsafe event concurrency
CI triggers, permissions, concurrency, and credentials are safe for public pull requests
packaged managed source inventory is stable and fully hashed
skill installation facade preserves its public export inventory
skill installation modules keep the intended acyclic dependency graph
task artifact facade preserves its public export inventory
task artifact modules keep the intended acyclic dependency graph
current dependency grammar accepts only the canonical sentinel or canonical bullets
every non-highest current state prevents a false all-complete verdict
batch transaction lock identity is versioned and a replacement lock is never unlinked
batch transaction revalidates dependency bytes and final targets under the held lock
explicit recovery rolls back a fully proven interrupted publication and is idempotent
rollback preserves changed pair bytes and linked extras instead of recursively cleaning them
